coordinateConvention.source: All region, polygon, origin and geometry-bearing parameter points are [u,v] normalized to the FULL exported PNG, top-left origin.
coordinateConvention.engineAlphaNormalized: Same corresponding points normalized to nonzero-alpha bounding rectangle. Formula u'=(u*width-alphaBounds.x)/alphaBounds.width, v'=(v*height-alphaBounds.y)/alphaBounds.height. Values are not clamped.
coordinateConvention.geometryNote: Regions are bounded effect/content envelopes, not pixel-perfect segmentation masks. Explicit mask/clip/exclusion requirements still apply. Do not treat a polygon covering glass as permission to paint through a specimen or a reflection.

timingConvention: Clock denominators reproduce native formulas and are not necessarily full periods. Keep world/prop phase when provided. Work means incoming f.work only; no invented fired, completion, occupancy or harness-vitals telemetry.
integrationStatus: Meaningful motion on baked content requires local deformation or isolated/underpainted content layers; generic screen pulses cannot substitute for fish, lava, plasma or specimen motion.
